findings.title: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy rejects the pods
findings.cause: Deployment kd-admission-policy-denies/web cannot create pods: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy kd-faults-require-team-label, through binding kd-faults-require-team-label, denies them: every pod needs a team label

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): Error creating: pods "web-5478fd465b-zzq2t" is forbidden: ValidatingAdmissionPolicy 'kd-faults-require-team-label' with binding 'kd-faults-require-team-label' denied request: every pod needs a team label

evidence.what: binding kd-faults-require-team-label: what it applies the policy to, and how

findings.fix: Change the pod template to pass the policy (its message says what it checks), or, if Deployment kd-admission-policy-denies/web should not apply here, narrow binding kd-faults-require-team-label's matchResources; validationActions Warn or Audit report without denying.
